title: Changing the sort shows the loading state, collapses expanded rows, and can change which customers are on the page
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission.
preconditions: 1. Enough customers exist to fill more than one page of results (seed ZZAUTOTEST customers if needed).
2. At least one customer is expanded.
steps: 1. Click a column header to change the sort and watch the table.
2. When the new order arrives, check the previously expanded rows and the set of customers on the page.
expected: 1. While the re-fetch is in flight the table shows the standard loading state; it clears when the re-ordered page arrives.
2. All previously expanded customer rows are collapsed (assets/invoices re-fetch lazily on the next expand).
3. The page shows the first page of the newly ordered full set — the customers on the page can change.
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite has no designs yet)
notes: Server-side sorting itself is covered by SBC-API-02. BUILD-DELTA: server-side sort/pagination is the 2026-07-16 committed target (spec ahead of code by design).
